Get to know the brand

What's the story behind ZipLip?

ZipLip is a fun, fruit-inspired beverage brand concept made to bring colour, flavour and a memorable name to everyday drink moments.

⚡🧃

Our brand idea

“Zip” brings to mind energy and excitement. “Lip” connects to the simple joy of taking a sip. Put them together and you get ZipLip — a name made to be remembered.

Zip the juice, sip on the lip!

🎨🍊

Our personality

Bright, playful, colourful and friendly. Our purple-and-yellow look helps the brand stand out, while each flavour gets its own fruit-inspired colour identity.

Big flavour energy. One fun name.

What we want customers to remember
🍍

Fruit-inspired choices

A range of familiar fruit combinations and flavour ideas.

💜

Easy to recognise

A distinctive name, slogan and colourful visual style.

🎒

Made for moments

A 200 ml concept pack designed around convenient drink occasions.

A closer look at our drinks

Each flavour has its own fruit inspiration, colour mood and taste description. These are proposed flavour concepts, not verified recipes or ingredient lists.

🥭🍊

Mango + Orange

Flavour mood: tropical, sweet and citrusy.

Fruit inspiration: ripe mango and bright orange.

Colour idea: sunny orange and golden yellow.

🍇🍯

Grape + Honey

Flavour mood: juicy grape with a gentle honey-inspired twist.

Fruit inspiration: purple grapes and honey.

Colour idea: rich grape purple and warm gold.

🍎

Apple Delight

Flavour mood: crisp and refreshing apple-inspired taste.

Fruit inspiration: red and green apples.

Colour idea: bright apple red.

🍓🫐

Mixed Berry

Flavour mood: a lively mix of sweet-and-tangy berry notes.

Fruit inspiration: strawberries, blueberries and raspberries.

Colour idea: berry blue and deep pink.

🍍🍋

Pineapple Cooler

Flavour mood: tropical pineapple with a citrus-inspired finish.

Fruit inspiration: pineapple and lemon.

Colour idea: sunny yellow.

Product information: The featured pack size is 200 ml and the suggested school-project price is ₹25. Need to know?

Frequently asked questions

What is ZipLip Juice?

ZipLip is a school-project beverage brand concept with five fruit-inspired flavour ideas.

What flavours are included?

Mango + Orange, Grape + Honey, Apple Delight, Mixed Berry and Pineapple Cooler.

Can I order from this website?

No. This is an informational project website. It does not accept orders or payments.

Are the ingredients or health claims verified?

No final recipe or nutrition testing has been provided. Any real product would need a safe, tested recipe, accurate ingredient labelling and required food-safety checks. No health benefits are being claimed here.
